lines: I want to hear the voice of the sky
So I strain my ears for the voice of the wind
I want to know the voice of the sea
And I'm searching for your voice
The more I think of how we can't meet
The more my longing to see you grows
The murmur of the river, the whisper of the mountains
They feel like your voice to me
When I close my eyes, I can hear it
Your rollicking laughter
If I sing it out loud, it just might reach you — so today too, I'm singing
Riding on the voice of the sea
I want to hear the voice of the sky
So I strain my ears for the voice of the wind
I want to know the voice of the sea
And I'm searching for your voice
It surfaces in the waves, then fades away
That innocent smiling face, like a child's
Even when I'm a gray-haired old man, I'll still be singing here
Yearning for you and you alone
O voice of the sea, O voice of the wind
O voice of the sky, O voice of the sun
O voice of the river, O voice of the mountains
Carry my voice along with you
I want to know the voice of the sea
And I'm searching for your voice
